clinical_intent: I am evaluating the use of artificial intelligence (AI) for brachytherapy planning. How can AI assist in: (1) automatic applicator reconstruction from CT/MRI, (2) automatic target volume delineation, (3) dose optimization, and (4) plan quality evaluation? What are the current limitations of AI in brachytherapy? What validation studies exist for AI-based brachytherapy planning?
